title: Hooded figures spraying plague from landed craft

tellings.quote: that Braramley did is that he found that the plague broke out only after these people would land in the fields, come out of these objects, land in, and they would go around with these hoods on and these spray cans that became the basis for the sid and the grim reaper image.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani cites a writer named William Bramley, author of a book called The Gods of Eden. Jorjani says Bramley found that the plague in medieval Europe broke out only after strange objects landed in fields and hooded figures came out carrying what looked like spray cans. According to this account, those figures became the source of the image of the Grim Reaper with his scythe, which would mean non-human beings spread the plague on purpose.
